text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Praise! Your attitude of striving together 
towards your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be cheering you on from the shadows! 
—Encouragement!

… She was very impressed with the way we 
practiced.
